kernel_profile_boundaries: Category percentages partition summed kernel duration. Concurrent kernels can overlap; the sum is not wall time or MFU.
Device unions measure recorded activity, not unprofiled execution or hardware utilization. Memcpy/memset activities are separate from the kernel sum.
Phase and execution scopes use CPU launch ancestry via correlation/External id. Nested inclusive scopes overlap and must not be added together.
Recognized phase annotations also use same-process launch timestamps across CPU threads. Concurrent CPU phases can overlap, so their phase totals remain inclusive.
CPU inclusive time contains nested calls; CPU self time subtracts the union of direct child intervals on that thread. Neither measures synchronized GPU update time.
FP8 requires kernel/ATen dtype evidence; BF16 and TF32 require explicit symbols or dtype records. Unknown GEMM precision remains Other GEMM.
Category rules are inspectable heuristics; unknown kernels stay Unmatched. A fusion can span several mathematical operations.
Input shapes are reported only when captured in the trace. Missing shapes are null, never inferred from an old or different run.
Warm-up, recomputation, optimizer inclusion and profiler overhead depend on the harness. A trace alone cannot establish production total RL throughput.

precision.scope: FP8 projection/head executed operands and shape-derived GEMM FLOPs only; not full MFU
boundaries: Executed work counts mathematical 2*M*N*K from actual Python operands, including padding, checkpoint forward recomputation, and head logits reconstruction; no kernel-internal tile padding count.
Useful estimate assumes three useful GEMMs per decoder projection/head token and omits gradient pruning; it is a nominal partial estimate, not measured MFU.
BF16 reference projection/head, GDN internal dots, attention dots, nonlinear/reduction/quantization/optimizer/DDP/rollout FLOPs are excluded.
Trace scope times are inclusive; do not sum nested scope times. Python dtype audit labels recomputation within policy_backward without separately marking every checkpoint scope.
Weight caches are invalidated by an actual fused Adam step with LR0 before the trace. This tests update-hook execution and cache refresh, not nonzero model learning.
Input uses historical unique completions replayed on one common prompt; original completion/prompt pairing is unavailable.

partial_FP8_GEMM_rate.boundary: Projection/head executed work over recognized FP8 kernel duration. Includes padding and recomputation. Not full-model useful MFU, not measured hardware counters. Dense H200 published FP8 peak, no sparsity.
